data.value: Reconciliation state of the provider-owned observation.

data.value: The last successful observation and latest discovery attempt.

data.value: Effective input content types after the provider override is applied.

data.value: Effective output content types after the provider override is applied.

data.name: LimitsHelp
data.value: Unknown limits remain unknown; overrides may only restrict a reported value.

data.name: YamlHelp
data.value: Exact persisted Model resource. Effective values computed from provider overrides are intentionally not serialized here.

data.name: ConcurrencyConflict
data.value: The model provider changed while you were editing.

data.name: UnableToSaveOverride
data.value: Unable to save the provider override

data.name: OverrideEditorHelp
data.value: Change only what discovery did not report correctly. Values that are not overridden continue to follow discovery.

data.name: CollectionOverrideHelp
data.value: Keep the value declared by the provider, or explicitly declare a value as available or unavailable.

data.name: FeatureOverrideHelp
data.value: Support and detail declarations remain bounded by explicit provider, adapter, runtime, and governance restrictions.

data.name: ToolGovernanceWarning
data.value: Declaring Tool support never grants Tool execution approval.

data.name: LimitOverrideHelp
data.value: The value declared by the provider is shown below each field. An unknown limit may be supplied; a known limit can only be reduced.

data.name: OverrideSaved
data.value: The provider override was saved and effective diagnostics were reloaded.

data.name: OverrideRemoved
data.value: The provider override was removed and the model now follows discovery.

data.value: The model is no longer currently discovered. This override remains attached to its retained exact identifier.
